overview: A single-page Department of State list-of-papers or cross-reference sheet for a file concerning Japanese news-gathering agencies operating in China. Its brief, partly illegible entry refers to false reports and asks that the matter be brought to the attention of the Japanese authorities; the sheet also contains several numerical filing references, although the OCR renders portions of the note and the principal decimal number uncertain.

subfiles.title: List of papers concerning Japanese news-gathering agencies in China
subfiles.about: The sheet identifies material about Japanese news-gathering agencies in China, false reports, and a request to alert Japanese authorities.
subfiles.summary: This Department of State form lists a subject concerning Japanese news-gathering agencies in China. A short and poorly recognized note mentions false reports and requests that the matter be brought to the attention of Japanese authorities. The page includes the OCR-rendered decimal number “194.91213” and additional numerical references, “391 391.1115a, 317,” which may point to related files.

interest: The sheet is useful chiefly as evidence of the State Department’s filing and cross-referencing practices rather than as a substantive report. It indicates official concern about false information attributed to Japanese news-gathering activity in China and suggests that diplomatic or administrative action toward Japanese authorities was contemplated. The damaged or inaccurate OCR also highlights the need to consult the original image before relying on the apparent reference to New Hampshire or on the rendered decimal-file numbers.
